journeys.consumer: ordinary C++ service or command-line application
journeys.topology: one process logger adapter; one repeated source call site; 4096 level and frequency checks; every 64th call formats and emits
journeys.ownership: the macro owns one hidden call-site counter; the application owns the synchronous adapter
journeys.reason: conditional and count-limited diagnostic output is common library and service behavior independent of inference

journeys.topology: 16 independently owned slots; 256 scheduler ticks at 50 ms; each slot admits progress at first observation and every 3 seconds; 80 records reach one process logger adapter
journeys.ownership: each request or slot owns its limiter; one loop timestamp may be shared across all slot checks; the application owns fan-out after the adapter
journeys.peer: llama.cpp server-context manual per-slot elapsed-time gate
journeys.reason: the server owns concurrent request lifetimes but registers one process-global logger callback; independent hidden call-site statics cannot model those lifetimes

negative_space.multi_sink: 2, 4 and 16 independent HYLE sinks are capacity/contention diagnostics, not the normal product topology
negative_space.async_fanout: queueing, file rotation, network export and application logger fan-out live behind the one synchronous adapter
negative_space.timing: the replay injects deterministic monotonic nanoseconds; clock acquisition is measured separately from the limiter mechanism
